# Preface {.unnumbered}

This Quarto book documents a many-analysts-style pilot on **convenience sampling bias**: when do effect-size estimates from non-representative samples generalise to the target population?

The single technical chapter is the confirmatory and exploratory simulation study in @sec-implementation (file `scripts/Simulation_study.qmd`). It implements:

* probabilistic (logistic) and deterministic (sinusoidal) range restriction on continuous $X$;
* Monte Carlo evaluation of mean relative bias and power via `Helper.R`;
* exploratory violations: collider / selection-induced endogeneity, confounding, negative-binomial mean–variance coupling, and linear mixed models with group-level selection.

HTML and PDF editions are built automatically on GitHub Actions and published to GitHub Pages.
